topic: Marketing: what we do when we take charge of your brand (4 things)
lines: Pachaas hazaar rupay ka marketing budget dein, hum yeh chaar kaam karte hain.
Ek: har hafte hook wali reels, jo bechne ke liye bani hon.
Do: ads, jahan har rupay ka hisaab ho.
Teen: WhatsApp aur DM automation, koi lead miss na ho.
Chaar: har hafte report, kitna kharch hua, kitna kamaya.
Aap maal sambhalo, marketing hum sambhalte hain.
Yeh reel kisi seller ko bhejein.
Brand hume dena hai? Comment BRAND.
